description: Expected results for the official C2F-W (Cell2Fire W) test case 'sb-asc' (test/model/sb-asc): Scott & Burgan fire model, 7x7 grid with one cell of each S&B fuel type, 113 fires, seed 123, scenario 1. inputs/ are the unmodified files from git HEAD of the C2F-W repo (commit 38ff0a0). All expected values were read FROM THE OFFICIAL TARGET FILES (reference/target_results.zip, target_results/sb-asc, unmodified copy from the repo). The official tolerance is exact: test/test.sh fails on any byte difference.
engine_version: Cell2Fire W built from fire2a/C2F-W git 38ff0a0 (2026-03-02); binary prints 'version: v0.0.0' (local build, no release tag)

numeric_checks.name: files_differing_from_official_target
numeric_checks.why: the official test (test/test.sh) passes only when every output file equals the official target byte for byte (after removing the log 'version:' line)

numeric_checks.name: n_output_files
numeric_checks.why: official target folder target_results/sb-asc holds 753 files (log, ignition log, 113 message files, 113 intensity grids, 525 grid snapshots)

numeric_checks.name: n_simulations_finished
numeric_checks.why: 113 fires asked for (--nsims 113); each ends with a 'Results' table whose Total row is 49 cells = 100.00%

numeric_checks.name: n_surface_intensity_files
numeric_checks.why: one surface fire intensity grid per fire (--out-intensity)

numeric_checks.name: n_ignition_log_rows
numeric_checks.why: one ignition cell per fire (--ignitionsLog); ignition points are drawn from seed 123

numeric_checks.name: non_burnable_cells
numeric_checks.why: the 7x7 fuel map has 6 cells that cannot burn (fuel codes 0, 91, 92, 93, 98, 99)

numeric_checks.name: message_scar_matches_log_burnt
numeric_checks.why: 1 = for every fire, ignition cell + cells reached by spread messages equals the Burnt count the model prints (inner consistency)

numeric_checks.name: burnt_cells_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean burnt cells per fire over the 113 fires, from the official log Burnt rows

numeric_checks.name: burnt_cells_min
numeric_checks.why: smallest fire in the official log

numeric_checks.name: total_spread_messages
numeric_checks.why: total cell-to-cell spread events over all 113 official message files

numeric_checks.name: max_spread_message_period
numeric_checks.why: latest fire period at which a spread happened (limit is 300 periods)

numeric_checks.name: burn_probability_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean over the 49 cells of the share of fires that burnt the cell

numeric_checks.name: burn_probability_max
numeric_checks.why: some cells burn in every fire

numeric_checks.name: surface_intensity_max
numeric_checks.why: largest surface fire intensity (kW/m) in the 113 official intensity grids

numeric_checks.name: surface_intensity_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean of all cells of the 113 official intensity grids (unburnt = 0)

finished_normally: return code 0 and 113 'Simulation N Results' tables with 'Total 49 100.00%' (checked as n_simulations_finished)
recorded_with: values computed by run_reference.py --print-metrics on the official target folder; a fresh run on this server matched all 753 target files byte for byte, two separate runs both identical
reference: reference/target_results.zip = test/target_results.zip from fire2a/C2F-W at 38ff0a0 (sha256 0361457b10af0b2cbd10484e4937491df4d9d9eabe952952388fc79cb4a7b6cf); only the target_results/sb-asc part is used
notes: Tolerance 0 for counts and 1e-9 for means, because the official check is an exact file match. The ForestGrid files written by --grids are timed snapshots, not the final burn scar, so burnt cells are taken from the spread messages plus the ignition cell. The only change to the run output before comparing is dropping the log 'version:' line, which the official test.sh also does.
